hydrogen technology, leveraging regional and national initiatives to develop sustainable energy solutions. These ecosystems align well with the Quintuple Helix innovation model,
which involves collaboration between five key actors: academia,
industry, government, civil society, and the environment.

open innovation model18, where the exchange of know-how

quintuple helix19 model that is a model in which innovation
is pushed by the integration in the classical triple helix model
of the needs expressed by the civil society and media and
